title: Sleep vs Symptom Burden Correlation
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=condition:symptom sleep_hours=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(severity) as avg_severity, avg(sleep_hours) as sleep_hours by _time
| sort _time
description: Compares daily symptom severity with logged sleep hours to reveal whether poor sleep precedes worse days.
value: Sleep is a common amplifier across many chronic conditions; plotting it next to symptom burden helps separate signal from guesswork.
implementation: Add sleep-hour context to symptom logs and chart daily severity versus average sleep.
visualization: Dual-axis line chart of sleep hours and symptom severity.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how your sleep and your bad days seem to move together.
